Origin and meaning

The name Ella has Germanic roots and means “all, completely”.

About the name Ella

A graceful short name shared by the jazz singer Ella Fitzgerald.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “all, completely”, an Ella calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
